strategies_benchmark.name: Strategy 0: Unsuppressed Baseline
strategies_benchmark.description: Standard detections without post-hoc geometric or reflection gating.

strategies_benchmark.name: Strategy 1: Aspect Ratio Anomaly Filtering
strategies_benchmark.description: Suppresses extreme aspect ratio boxes (w/h < 0.25 or > 4.5) unless confidence >= 0.50.

strategies_benchmark.name: Strategy 2: Road Surface Reflection Gating
strategies_benchmark.description: Suppresses weak Car detections (score < 0.28) in the bottom 20% of the image.

strategies_benchmark.name: Strategy 3: Cross-Resolution Spatial Confirmation
strategies_benchmark.description: Requires predictions with score in [0.20, 0.28] to be confirmed by secondary resolution pass.

strategies_benchmark.name: Strategy 4: Combined Adaptive Suppression
strategies_benchmark.description: Combines geometric aspect filtering, road reflection gating, and cross-resolution confirmation.
